preconditions.description: Must have riskControl role or equivalent permission to close positions
Contract must have WBTC tokens available for insurance fund transfers

exploit_hint: Exploit the missing state update when riskControl closes a position. After insurance funds are transferred to the user, the user's available funds variable is not reset to zero. This allows the user to withdraw the same funds multiple times. As an attacker with riskControl permissions, trigger position closure to transfer insurance funds, then call withdrawal functions repeatedly to drain remaining contract balance.
